name: default
description: House look for generated b-roll: documentary photography, no lettering, composed to survive a crop
system:
Photographic, documentary. Real materials, real light, plausible imperfection — grain, dust, wear, weather. Depth of field from a real lens rather than a blur filter.
Compose for a CENTRE CROP: the video is a different shape from this frame, so keep the subject and everything that matters well inside the middle, and leave the edges expendable.
Never draw text of any kind — no captions, titles, labels, signage lettering, numbers, subtitles, watermarks, logos or signatures. Every word this video shows is drawn by the renderer on top of you, and lettering underneath fights it.
One scene, one moment. No collage, no split screens, no panels, no borders or frames, no montage of several images.
